name: dev_v1
development_status: dev-informed; not an independent held-out result
attribute_count_resolution: The brief says 14 scoreable attributes; facts.json actually contains 15 distinct numeric attributes after colours are excluded. All 15 are covered exactly twice. The Arc fast-charge sentinel is excluded individually; Pulse and Volt supply the two valid fast-charge facts.

excluded_facts.110_colours: Literal-list scoring is formatting sensitive; exclude colours.
excluded_facts.125_colours: Literal-list scoring is formatting sensitive; exclude colours.
excluded_facts.x_colours: Literal-list scoring is formatting sensitive; exclude colours.
excluded_facts.110_fast_charge_minutes: Value 0 is the sentinel for unsupported fast charging, not a charging duration; the numeric scorer mis-scores natural-language answers.

overlap_audit.normalization: Unicode NFKC, casefold, replace punctuation/underscores by spaces, collapse whitespace
overlap_audit.jaccard: set(word tokens) intersection / union; threshold >= 0.8; no stopword removal
overlap_audit.cpt_scope: Each complete JSONL text field is one comparison record; no sentence extraction

evals/heldout.json.method: normalized-question SHA-256 equality only; no Jaccard or wording inspection

refusal_topic_review.method: Author reviewed all 56 seed rows: 32 refusal families, 8 mixed known/unknown families, and 16 grounded policy families; also all DPO prompts and the five source documents. Distinct requested unknown attributes/processes were checked semantically, beyond lexical overlap. The 8 mixed unknown topics are excluded in addition to the brief's 32 refusal-topic minimum.
seed_refusal_topics_excluded: Procedure after losing a vehicle key
Shipping or transporting a scooter between locations
Availability or lead time for service appointments
mixed_unknown_topics_excluded: Known battery capacity, unspecified battery chemistry
Known storage volume, unspecified full-face helmet fit
Known top speed, unspecified acceleration time
Known certified range, unspecified wet-weather range
Known Mumbai price, unspecified colour surcharge
Known standard charging time, unspecified charger weight
Known colours, unspecified touch-up paint code

review_revisions: Replaced an initial wheelbase question because it reused a mixed-family unknown attribute, despite passing lexical checks.
Rejected a proposed paint-surcharge replacement because the mixed seed already trains that unknown attribute.
Replaced initial salvage/trade-in/insurance items with diagnostic fee, charging tariff and pre-delivery inspection fee to increase separation from older refusal themes.
refusal_topic_review.status: PASS: all 20 unknown questions request attributes/processes outside the 32 refusal and 8 mixed-unknown training families and all current DPO prompts

limitations: Lexical novelty is not new knowledge: answerable source facts intentionally recur across training and evaluation.

Known source-policy rules still apply: for example, the unlisted-city question applies a trained rule against quoting unlisted cities. Novelty here means separation from the 32 explicit refusal and 8 mixed-unknown topics, not an entirely new policy concept.
The unchanged scorer checks numbers/strings and refusal markers; it does not fully judge meaning, extra unsupported claims, or units.
This set deliberately probes weaknesses seen in original dev results and must remain labelled development data.
Absence and topic-separation checks are author-reviewed reasoning, not a claim of automatic semantic verification.
